horses.flag: parent of six sub-themes; kept horse kinds (mare, foal, steed), gaits, sounds and core equestrian words that fit none of the sub-themes

turkish animals.flag: about 30: few animals are specific to Turkey; list is mostly breeds named for Turkey or Anatolia plus emblematic Turkish wildlife, many of them obscure

asian animals.flag: residual after the Indian, Himalayan, Japanese and Southeast Asian sub-themes: mostly Chinese, Mongolian, Siberian and Central Asian species

antarctic animals.flag: only about 21 outside penguins; animals that also live in the Arctic or every ocean (orca, blue whale, humpback) left out to keep it apart from arctic animals

south american animals.flag: residual after the Amazon, Andean and Galapagos sub-themes: Pampas, Patagonia, Pantanal and Atlantic forest species, so mostly obscure

european animals.flag: residual after the British wildlife and alpine sub-themes; species common in Britain (red deer, badger, fox) are left to that sub-theme
